title: Hardware-Matched Spiking Neural Networks for Real-Time Purkinje Cell Spike Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.37104v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distinguishing Purkinje cell (PC) simple spikes (SSs) from complex spikes (CSs) is key to studying cerebellar function. PC recordings commonly rely on wired headstages, whose tethers restrict natural movement in freely behaving animals. Untethered headstages remove this constraint, but cannot continuously transmit raw recordings within their power budgets, making on-headstage spike classification an attractive form of compression, provided it runs accurately in real time on constrained hardware. This work presents two compact spiking neural networks (SNNs) matched to their target hardware: ConvSNN, which maps to the Matrix Vector Processor (MVP) of an EFM32PG28 microcontroller, and StreamSNN, which processes one waveform value per timestep using learned time constants and fixed synaptic delays for a dedicated SKY130 circuit. Evaluated on cells unseen during training, ConvSNN achieves a CS F1 of 0.873 with 1,018 parameters and StreamSNN

translated_title: 面向浦肯野细胞尖峰实时分类的硬件匹配脉冲神经网络
translated_abstract: 区分浦肯野细胞（PC）的简单尖峰（SSs）与复杂尖峰（CSs）是研究小脑功能的关键。PC 记录通常依赖有线头台，其线缆限制了自由活动动物的自然运动。无线头台消除了这一限制，但在其功耗预算内无法连续传输原始记录数据，因此头台上的尖峰分类成为一种有吸引力的数据压缩方式——前提是它能在受限硬件上实时且准确地运行。本工作提出了两个与其目标硬件相匹配的紧凑脉冲神经网络（SNNs）：ConvSNN 映射到 EFM32PG28 微控制器的矩阵向量处理器（MVP）；StreamSNN 则在每个时间步处理一个波形值，采用学习得到的时间常数和固定的突触延迟，面向专用的 SKY130 电路。在训练中未见过的细胞上进行评估，ConvSNN 仅用 1,018 个参数即达到 CS F1 分数 0.873，StreamSNN
tldr: 本文提出两种与目标硬件紧密匹配的紧凑脉冲神经网络，可在微控制器和专用电路等受限硬件上实时、准确地分类浦肯野细胞的简单尖峰与复杂尖峰，为无线记录头台实现片上数据压缩提供了解决方案。
en_tdlr: This paper presents two compact spiking neural networks hardware-matched to constrained targets (a microcontroller's MVP and a dedicated SKY130 circuit) that classify Purkinje cell simple and complex spikes accurately in real time, enabling on-headstage spike compression for wireless recordings.
